name: classic-cinema-scripts
description: Bun package for the classic-cinema skill. Owns the listing, availability, ticket-parse, seat-pick, ticket-fill, and heal-skill command surfaces. Uses only Bun built-ins (fetch, Bun.file, Bun.write) so the skill travels as a standalone zip.

scripts.build:bundle: NODE_ENV=production bun build --target bun --minify-whitespace src/list-movies.ts src/check-availability.ts src/parse-tickets.ts src/pick-seats.ts src/fill-ticket.ts src/heal-skill.ts --outdir dist
